title_as_printed: Measured and predicted solubilities of liquid CO2 in water x_w(CO2)
pressure_note: system pressure set with a mercury-column/piston-pump control, 'p/MPa'; the paper does not say total/partial/gauge/absolute; CO2 is a liquid phase in contact with the water column (p > 6 MPa)

value.what: measured value, one column per temperature block in the print; blocks stacked

extra_unmapped: Predicted x_w(CO2) (predicted by the authors' Henry-law correlation / density relation, model-generated)

notes: Four side-by-side T blocks (Measured, Predicted) stacked in order 278, 283, 288, 293 K. Column 'Predicted' is model output, kept as printed but not a datum. Hydrate film at the CO2-water interface at T <= 283 K per authors (regime kept lle; authors say its effect on the solubility is negligible). x_w(CO2) = Cs/[(Cs+rho(H2O))/M(H2O)] with Cs = n(CO2)/V(H2O) (Eq. 2), i.e. CO2 mole fraction in the aqueous phase.
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: Regime per temperature block from the paper (p.1303-1304): hydrate present at the interface for T <= 283 K ('the hydrate CO2.5.75H2O forms only at the interface', 'a thin hydrate phase ... remained at the interface'), only a quasi-crystalline interfacial structure above 283 K, so those blocks stay lle.
